Make a one-of-a-kind mosaic in one of Austin's only hands-on workshops led by professional artists!

Our spacious art studio located in the heart of East Austin is filled with artistic inspiration and features like custom worktables, a cozy lounge area, a relaxing garden courtyard, and more.

Led by The Mosaic Workshop's team of expert instructors, we offer an unforgettable experience for visitors and local Austinites alike.
